  {
    name: 'discover',
    invoke: 'fgos discover',
    description: 'Run context-discovery for an item at stage discovery or exploring, or query/advance its Workflow run if bound to one. A clear verdict moves the item forward to planning; an unclear verdict at discovery moves it on to exploring and parks it in awaiting-human. When bound to a workflow run, delegates to or reports workflow step status with clear guidance on the unified "fgos workflow" door. Errors if the item is at any other stage -- use "plan" for a planning-stage item. --verdict lets a caller that already reasoned about clarity supply its own verdict directly.',
    retiredFlags: ['tier'],
    parameters: {
      type: 'object',
      properties: {
        worktree: { type: 'string', description: "Worktree path when resuming an existing discovery run." },
        id: { type: 'string', description: 'Work item id (positional or --id).' },
        config: { type: 'string', description: 'Path to the runner config (default .fgos/config.json in cwd).' },
        verdict: { type: 'string', description: 'Optional caller-supplied verdict: "clear" or "unclear". Omit it only when the item already carries a committed, non-empty CONTEXT.md under its docsRef -- that readLockedContext trust signal advances the item without a verdict. With neither, the call refuses: no subprocess judge stands behind this verb anymore.' },
        verify: { type: 'string', description: 'Required with --verdict clear: the real, runnable verify command for this item.' },
        question: { type: 'string', description: 'Required with --verdict unclear: the question to park the item on in awaiting-human.' },
        force: { type: 'boolean', description: 'Only meaningful with --verdict clear: proceed past a disputed second-pass verify judge instead of parking in awaiting-human. Always logged as a decision naming the disagreement it overrode -- never a silent bypass.' },
        size: { type: 'string', description: "Only meaningful with --verdict clear: the size this discovery pass judged for the item ('light'/'standard'/'heavy'), applied once the outcome actually resolves clear. Omit to leave the item's size unchanged." },
        rigor: { type: 'string', description: "Only meaningful with --verdict clear: the rigor this discovery pass judged for the item ('low'/'standard'/'high'/'critical'), applied once the outcome actually resolves clear. Omit to leave the item's rigor unchanged." },
        kind: { type: 'string', description: "Only meaningful with --verdict clear: the kind this discovery pass judged for the item, from the item's own domain vocabulary (coding: bug/chore/design/docs/feature/task). An out-of-vocabulary value is refused as validation before the item moves at all. Omit to leave the item's kind unchanged." },
        risk: { type: 'string', description: "Only meaningful with --verdict clear: the risk this discovery pass judged for the item ('light'/'standard'/'heavy'). An out-of-vocabulary value is refused as validation before the item moves at all. Omit to leave the item's risk unchanged." },
        resume: { type: 'boolean', description: 'When bound to a workflow run, resumes execution of the workflow run.' },
      },
      positional: ['id'],
      required: ['id'],
    },
    examples: ['fgos discover build-cli', 'fgos discover build-cli --verdict clear --verify "npm test"', 'fgos discover build-cli --verdict clear --verify "npm test" --force'],
    touchesState: true,
    requiresExistingStore: true,
    externalEffect: false,
    paginated: false,
    deprecated: null,
  },
  {
    name: 'plan',
    invoke: 'fgos plan',
    description: 'Run chia-viec (split-work judgment) for an item at stage planning, or query/advance its Workflow run if bound to one. Moving forward advances to executing (pass-through or split into children) or parks in awaiting-human. When bound to a workflow run, delegates to or reports workflow step status with clear guidance on the unified "fgos workflow" door. Errors if the item is not at stage planning -- use "discover" for an item still at stage discovery or exploring. --verdict lets a caller supply its own verdict directly.',
    parameters: {
      type: 'object',
      properties: {
        worktree: { type: 'string', description: "Worktree path when resuming an existing planning run." },
        id: { type: 'string', description: 'Work item id (positional or --id).' },
        config: { type: 'string', description: 'Path to the runner config (default .fgos/config.json in cwd).' },
        verdict: { type: 'string', description: 'Optional caller-supplied verdict: "pass-through", "need-human", or "decompose" (this value name is unchanged, tsk-403 D11 -- it names an outcome, not a stage). Omit it only when the item\'s plan.md declares tiny/small mode -- that skip-and-advance trust signal passes the item through without a verdict. With neither, the call refuses: no subprocess judge stands behind this verb anymore.' },
        reason: { type: 'string', description: 'Required with --verdict need-human or --verdict decompose (optional with pass-through): why this call is verdicting the way it is.' },
        children: { type: 'string', description: 'Required with --verdict decompose: JSON-encoded array of child objects ({title, verify, kind?, risk?, refs?, footprint?, deps?}).', multiValueFormat: 'json-array' },
        force: { type: 'boolean', description: 'Only meaningful with --verdict decompose: proceed past a disputed second-pass verify judge on a child, instead of parking the whole decompose verdict in awaiting-human. Always logged as a decision naming the disagreement it overrode -- never a silent bypass. Mirrors discover --force (tsk-5cf D1b).' },
        validate: { type: 'boolean', description: 'Explicitly run reviewer validation (planning.validate-plan) before processing the plan verdict.' },
        direct: { type: 'boolean', description: 'Bypass reviewer validation (planning.validate-plan) and proceed directly to resolvePlan.' },
        resume: { type: 'boolean', description: 'When bound to a workflow run, resumes execution of the workflow run.' },
      },
      positional: ['id'],
      required: ['id'],
    },
    examples: ['fgos plan build-cli', 'fgos plan build-cli --verdict pass-through --reason "single-piece, no split needed"'],
    touchesState: true,
    requiresExistingStore: true,
    externalEffect: false,
    paginated: false,
    deprecated: null,
  },
  {
    name: 'move',
    invoke: 'fgos move',
    description: 'Move a work item to a new status through the FSM, with an optional CAS guard.',
    parameters: {
      type: 'object',
      properties: {
        'override-reason': { type: 'string', description: "Reason recorded when moving to delivered over an unmet gate." },
        id: { type: 'string', description: 'Work item id (positional or --id).' },
        to: { type: 'string', description: 'Target status to move to.' },
        expect: { type: 'string', description: 'Optional CAS guard: the expected current status.' },
        reason: { type: 'string', description: 'Optional reason; required by the FSM on specific edges (e.g. awaiting-approval -> blocked/todo).' },
        'skip-return-guard': { type: 'string', description: 'Required, non-empty reason to force --to awaiting-approval on a "doing" item without going through fgos return\'s own proof-of-progress checks (branch-advance, clean tree, verify pass). Omit entirely when the item is not "doing". Logged to the decision log.' },
        answer: { type: 'string', description: 'Optional answer text when resuming or closing an item out of awaiting-human.' },
        approve: { type: 'boolean', description: 'The owner explicitly approves what the question proposed; only this releases a consent gate. Without it the answer is a clarification and the item is asked again.' },
      },
      positional: ['id'],
      required: ['id', 'to'],
    },
    examples: ['fgos move build-cli --to doing', 'fgos move build-cli --to todo --answer "Approved" --approve'],
    touchesState: true,
    requiresExistingStore: true,
    externalEffect: false,
    paginated: false,
    deprecated: null,
  },
  {
    name: 'retrospective',
    invoke: 'fgos retrospective',
    description: 'Batch sweep, run once per invocation: moves every delivered item to retrospective (the mechanical claim step). Never runs the synthesis itself — that is a session\'s own separate work while an item sits at retrospective.',
    parameters: {
      type: 'object',
      properties: {},
      positional: [],
      required: [],
    },
    examples: ['fgos retrospective'],
    touchesState: true,
    requiresExistingStore: true,
    externalEffect: false,
    paginated: false,
    deprecated: null,
  },
  {
    name: 'cleanup',
    invoke: 'fgos cleanup',
    description: 'Finish a cleanup-parked item: verifies the global TTL has elapsed, retrospective produced real content, and (worktree-backed domains only) the merge still resolves on main, then deletes the branch/worktree and closes to done. Any check failing parks cleanup -> blocked with every failing reason.',
    parameters: {
      type: 'object',
      properties: {
        id: { type: 'string', description: 'Work item id (positional or --id).' },
      },
      positional: ['id'],
      required: ['id'],
    },
    examples: ['fgos cleanup build-cli'],
    touchesState: true,
    requiresExistingStore: true,
    externalEffect: true,
    paginated: false,
    deprecated: null,
  },
  {
    name: 'compound',
    invoke: 'fgos compound',
    description: 'Tag a retrospective-status work item\'s outcome with a Diataxis doc-type/doc-path linkage (tutorial | how-to | reference | explanation) -- the producer surface fgos-coding-compounding uses to record its synthesis classification. Requires the item to be at status "retrospective"; omitted --doc-type is a no-op.',
    parameters: {
      type: 'object',
      properties: {
        id: { type: 'string', description: 'Work item id (positional or --id).' },
        'doc-type': { type: 'string', description: 'Optional Diataxis quadrant to tag the capture with: tutorial | how-to | reference | explanation. Omit to leave the item untagged (no-op).' },
        'doc-path': { type: 'string', description: 'Optional end-user doc path this capture links to, alongside --doc-type.' },
      },
      positional: ['id'],
      required: ['id'],
    },
    examples: ['fgos compound tsk-3o3 --doc-type how-to --doc-path docs/how-to/example.md'],
    touchesState: true,
    requiresExistingStore: true,
    externalEffect: false,
    paginated: false,
    deprecated: 'fgos doc reserve/register/promote',
  },
  {
    name: 'edit',
    invoke: 'fgos edit',
    description: 'Patch fields on an existing item (title/description/kind/risk/verify/tier/refs/deps/footprint/action/acceptance/priority/intent/docs-ref/parent/urgent/impact/effort/merge-after). At least one field must be given.',
    retiredFlags: ['tier'],
    parameters: {
      type: 'object',
      properties: {
        role: { type: 'string', description: "Acting role: human (default) or session." },
        duplicates: { type: 'string', description: "Comma-separated ids this item duplicates (empty string clears)." },
        'domain-fields': { type: 'string', description: "JSON-encoded object ({ [domainName]: {...} }) of domain-specific fields." },
        'goal-tier': { type: 'string', description: "Goal tier: mvp or milestone." },
        'superseded-by': { type: 'string', description: "Id of the item that supersedes this one (empty string clears)." },
        'verify-from-children': { type: 'boolean', description: "Derive the verify command from the children items." },
        'verify-from-targets': { type: 'boolean', description: "Derive the verify command from the item targets." },
        id: { type: 'string', description: 'Work item id (positional or --id).' },
        title: { type: 'string', description: 'New title.' },
        description: { type: 'string', description: 'New full-text intake description. Must be a non-empty string when present -- unlike refs/deps/footprint, an empty value is rejected as validation rather than clearing the field.' },
        kind: { type: 'string', description: 'New kind.' },
        risk: { type: 'string', description: 'New risk level.' },
        verify: { type: 'string', description: 'New verification command/plan.' },
        size: { type: 'string', description: 'New size (light/standard/heavy).' },
        rigor: { type: 'string', description: 'New rigor (low/standard/high/critical).' },
        refs: { type: 'string', description: 'Comma-separated list of reference ids/links (empty string clears the field).', multiValueFormat: 'csv' },
        deps: { type: 'string', description: 'Comma-separated list of dependency ids (empty string clears the field).', multiValueFormat: 'csv' },
        footprint: { type: 'string', description: 'Comma-separated list of file paths this item is expected to touch (advisory only); empty string clears the field.', multiValueFormat: 'csv' },
        action: { type: 'string', description: 'New action directive sentence (e.g. for worker prompt). Must be a non-empty string when present -- unlike refs/deps/footprint, an empty value is rejected as validation rather than clearing the field.' },
        parent: { type: 'string', description: 'New lineage parent id (empty string "" clears the field, un-parenting the item).' },
        acceptance: { type: 'string', description: 'Optional JSON-encoded array of {text, evidence} Condition-of-Satisfaction clauses — replaces the whole array (empty array "[]" clears the field). NOT comma-separated — clause text may contain commas.', multiValueFormat: 'json-array' },
        priority: { type: 'integer', description: 'New priority: a non-negative integer, ascending sort (lower = higher priority). Absent stays absent — items without a priority sort after every item that has one.' },
        intent: { type: 'integer', description: 'New intent score: any integer, descending sort (higher = more urgent). Absent stays absent — items without an intent sort after every item that has one.' },
        'docs-ref': { type: 'string', description: 'New relative path to this item\'s docs/history/<feature>/ directory (its own CONTEXT.md/plan.md) — lets an item gain or change this link after creation, e.g. one created via submit (which had no --docs-ref of its own before this field was added here).' },
        urgent: { type: 'string', description: 'New urgency level: one of low/medium/high/critical, human-entered. Absent reads as medium at the priority formula, never stored as a default here.' },
        impact: { type: 'number', description: 'New impact score: a non-negative number, computed (blocking fan-out + semantic scan + de-risk bonus) — not typically human-entered directly.' },
        effort: { type: 'number', description: 'New effort score: a non-negative number, computed from fgos-coding-planning\'s mode/flag-count — not typically human-entered directly.' },
        'merge-after': { type: 'string', description: 'Comma-separated list of ids this item must merge AFTER (empty string clears the field). A weak, merge-order-only edge — blocks this item\'s MERGE until every target is resolved, but never blocks its own start/dispatch the way deps does. Validated at set-time: target existence, no self-reference, no cycle (including a cycle mixed with deps/parent).', multiValueFormat: 'csv' },
      },
      positional: ['id'],
      required: ['id'],
    },
    examples: ['fgos edit build-cli --verify "npm test -- --grep cli"'],
    touchesState: true,
    requiresExistingStore: true,
    externalEffect: false,
    paginated: false,
    deprecated: null,
  },
  {
    name: 'resolve-park-reason',
    invoke: 'fgos resolve-park-reason',
    description: 'Clear a stale reason/parkReason left over from a system-error park event on a closed item (status "done" or "wontfix"), requiring a non-empty --note justifying the resolution for the audit trail.',
    parameters: {
      type: 'object',
      properties: {
        role: { type: 'string', description: "Acting role: human (default) or session." },
        id: { type: 'string', description: 'Work item id (positional or --id).' },
        note: { type: 'string', description: 'Human-confirmed rationale/note for clearing the stale reason (required).' },
      },
      positional: ['id'],
      required: ['id', 'note'],
    },
    examples: ['fgos resolve-park-reason tsk-64h --note "Human confirmed present on main branch"'],
    touchesState: true,
    requiresExistingStore: true,
    externalEffect: false,
    paginated: false,
    deprecated: null,
  },
  {
    name: 'ask',
    invoke: 'fgos ask',
    description: 'Park an item in awaiting-human, carrying the question it is waiting on.',
    parameters: {
      type: 'object',
      properties: {
        source: { type: 'string', description: "Where the question came from." },
        id: { type: 'string', description: 'Work item id (positional or --id).' },
        text: { type: 'string', description: 'The question text.' },
        expect: { type: 'string', description: 'Optional CAS guard: the expected current status.' },
      },
      positional: ['id'],
      required: ['id', 'text'],
    },
    examples: ['fgos ask build-cli --text "Which module owns this?"'],
    touchesState: true,
    requiresExistingStore: true,
    externalEffect: false,
    paginated: false,
    deprecated: null,
  },
  {
    name: 'answer',
    invoke: 'fgos answer',
    description: 'Record the answer to a parked question and resume the item to its status before the question was asked (todo, or doing if a claim was held).',
    parameters: {
      type: 'object',
      properties: {
        rationale: { type: 'string', description: "Why this answer." },
        alternatives: { type: 'string', description: "Alternatives that were considered." },
        source: { type: 'string', description: "Where the answer came from." },
        id: { type: 'string', description: 'Work item id (positional or --id).' },
        text: { type: 'string', description: 'The answer text.' },
        approve: { type: 'boolean', description: 'The owner explicitly approves what the question proposed; only this releases a consent gate. Without it the answer is a clarification and the item is asked again.' },
        expect: { type: 'string', description: 'Optional CAS guard: the expected current status.' },
      },
      positional: ['id'],

properties: {
            'run-id': { type: 'string', description: 'The runId to recover (positional, --run-id or --run).' },
            run: { type: 'string', description: 'Same as --run-id.' },
            intent: { type: 'string', description: 'Without --action only: "resume" (default; for an attempt of the run supervisor the recommendation is `adopt`), "reassign" (needs replacement-authority evidence in the run\'s controller directory, or the recommendation comes back "needs-input") or "abandon-legacy" (a run from before the run supervisor, settled only on proof that every process it recorded is dead).' },
            action: { type: 'string', description: 'JSON-encoded action object to apply, exactly as returned by a prior recover call\'s own `action` field. Its presence selects the apply path.' },
            'expected-snapshot': { type: 'string', description: 'Apply only: the `snapshotHash` from the recommendation being applied.' },
            'expected-control-epoch': { type: 'string', description: 'Apply only: the `expectedControlEpoch` from the recommendation being applied.' },
            'expected-expires-at': { type: 'string', description: 'Apply only: the `expiresAt` from the recommendation being applied.' },
            'action-key': { type: 'string', description: 'Apply only: the `actionKey` from the recommendation being applied. Consumed exactly once -- a repeat call with the same key returns the prior recorded outcome instead of repeating the effect.' },
          },
          positional: ['run-id'],
          required: ['run-id'],
        },
        examples: [
          'fgos dispatch recover run_abc123',
          'fgos dispatch recover run_abc123 --intent reassign',
          'fgos dispatch recover run_abc123 --action \'{"type":"resume-driver"}\' --expected-snapshot <hash> --expected-control-epoch 0 --expected-expires-at <iso> --action-key <key>',
        ],
      },
      reconcile: {
        description: '"plan" (the default) plans one guard repair, "apply --plan" applies a plan it returned, "provider-capacity quarantine|clear-quarantine" sets or clears an account\'s quarantine. Never recovers, launches, signals, or controls a Run.',
        parameters: {
          type: 'object',
          properties: {
            mode: { type: 'string', description: 'Positional: plan (default), apply, or provider-capacity.', enum: ['plan', 'apply', 'provider-capacity'] },
            'capacity-action': { type: 'string', description: 'Positional after provider-capacity: quarantine or clear-quarantine.', enum: ['quarantine', 'clear-quarantine'] },
            action: { type: 'string', description: '"plan" only: the action kind to plan, one of "clear-cwd-lock" (default), "collect-result" (requires --run), or "repair-projection" (requires --run).' },
            run: { type: 'string', description: '"plan" only: target runId for collect-result or repair-projection.' },
            'run-id': { type: 'string', description: '"plan" only: same as --run.' },
            cwd: { type: 'string', description: '"plan" only: the working directory whose per-cwd dispatch lock clear-cwd-lock reports on (default: the current directory).' },
            plan: { type: 'string', description: '"apply" only: JSON-encoded plan returned by `dispatch reconcile plan`.' },
            provider: { type: 'string', description: 'provider-capacity: provider id as `inspect --provider-capacity` lists it, e.g. openai-codex.' },
            account: { type: 'string', description: 'provider-capacity: account id from ~/.fgos/config.json.' },
            reason: { type: 'string', description: 'provider-capacity: operator reason, e.g. token refreshed or quota exhausted.' },
            until: { type: 'string', description: 'quarantine only: ISO date-time (in the future) when the account is selectable again.' },
            force: { type: 'boolean', description: 'clear-quarantine only: permit clearing an account that is not currently quarantined.' },
          },
          positional: ['mode', 'capacity-action'],
          required: [],
        },
        examples: [
          'fgos dispatch reconcile plan',
          'fgos dispatch reconcile plan --action collect-result --run run_abc123',
          'fgos dispatch reconcile apply --plan \'<plan-json>\'',
          'fgos dispatch reconcile provider-capacity quarantine --provider openai-codex --account acct1 --reason "quota exhausted" --until 2026-12-31T00:00:00Z',
          'fgos dispatch reconcile provider-capacity clear-quarantine --provider openai-codex --account acct1 --reason "token refreshed"',
        ],
      },
      decide: {
        description: 'Answer which mechanism (in-process, out-of-process, unavailable) and executor a dispatch resolves to, via bind(); runs nothing. Name an executor, a purpose (--for), or a work item (--work).',
        parameters: {
          type: 'object',
          properties: {
            'executor-id': { type: 'string', description: 'Positional: an exact executor id to resolve.' },
            for: { type: 'string', description: 'Capability or purpose name to resolve when no executor is named.' },
            work: { type: 'string', description: 'Work item id to resolve.' },
            stage: { type: 'string', description: 'With --work: the work item stage.' },
            assignment: { type: 'string', description: 'Assignment id to resolve against.' },
            'has-live-task-access': { type: 'boolean', description: 'Caller self-declares it has a live Agent/Task tool.' },
            'needs-soul': { type: 'boolean', description: 'The task requires an agent soul.' },
            cwd: { type: 'string', description: 'Working directory to resolve from (default: the current directory; --dir is accepted too).' },
            'repo-root': { type: 'string', description: 'Main checkout repository root.' },
          },
          positional: ['executor-id'],
          required: [],
        },
        examples: [
          'fgos dispatch decide judge-discovery',
          'fgos dispatch decide --for general-purpose --has-live-task-access',
          'fgos dispatch decide --work tsk-abc --stage planning',
        ],
      },
      explain: {
        description: 'Why a capability binds where it does, read-only: binds it as a run would (bind()), then reports the family and the prefer entry that chose it, the tier, its source (rigor, override) and its ceiling (runner.maxTier, or the capability\'s own rigor when that is higher), the candidates in order with the reason one is out (a missing tier cell, a pool with no usable account), the walk a seat takes when each binding fails, and the accounts of each pool on that walk in the order the lease takes them, with whether the CLI can run on each. Leases, spawns and writes nothing.',
        parameters: {
          type: 'object',
          properties: {
            for: { type: 'string', description: 'The capability to explain.' },
            rigor: { type: 'string', description: 'The unit rigor to bind with (low, standard, high, critical); omitted, the capability\'s own rigor applies.' },
          },
          required: ['for'],
        },
        examples: ['fgos dispatch explain --for code:implement', 'fgos dispatch explain --for architecture:synthesize --rigor critical'],
      },
      'probe-account': {
        description: 'Diagnostic: start every CLI configured for one provider account at the same moment through the real dispatch door (confinement, leased login, herdr pane) with a read-only prompt; report per CLI an outcome class (ok, blocked-trust-prompt, auth, quota, sandbox, timeout, other) with its evidence line and run/pane refs plus an account-fault vs cli-fault verdict, and close the panes it opened. Selects and schedules nothing.',
        parameters: {
          type: 'object',
          properties: {
            provider: { type: 'string', description: 'Provider id, e.g. openai.' },
            account: { type: 'string', description: 'Account id from ~/.fgos/config.json.' },
            executor: { type: 'string', description: 'Limit the probe to one executor id (default: every executor of the provider).' },
            invocation: { type: 'string', description: 'Comma-separated invocation ids to limit the probe to (default: every invocation that runs as the account).' },
            'timeout-ms': { type: 'string', description: 'Per-call timeout in milliseconds.' },
            cwd: { type: 'string', description: 'Working directory the probe runs in (default: the current directory; --dir is accepted too).' },
            'repo-root': { type: 'string', description: 'Main checkout repository root.' },
          },
          required: ['provider', 'account'],
        },
        examples: ['fgos dispatch probe-account --provider openai --account tetcu72'],
      },
    },
    examples: [
      'fgos dispatch decide --for general-purpose --has-live-task-access',
      'fgos dispatch show-run run_abc123',
      'fgos dispatch inspect --run run_abc123',
      'fgos dispatch reconcile plan',
    ],
    touchesState: true,
    // "reconcile"/"recover" write guard and Run state (touchesState: true);
    // "probe-account" spawns provider CLIs (externalEffect: true). A verb with
    // several sub-modes is classified by its most-privileged effect on each axis.
    requiresExistingStore: false,
    externalEffect: true,
    paginated: false,
    deprecated: null,
  }),
  {
    name: 'run',
    invoke: 'fgos run ["<prompt>" [--provider <id>[,<id>...]] [--persona <name>] [--writes <a>,<b>] [--capability <c>] [--rigor <r>] [--input <a>,<b>] [--verify "<cmd>"] [--sync <ref>] | --sync <ref> --writes <a>,<b> | --unit <file|-> | --resume <unitRunId>] [--pattern <name|preset>] [--override <json>] [--effort <low|medium|high|max>] [--timeout <dur>] [--account <pool/account>] [--worktree <wt>] [--dir <mainRoot>] [--json]',
    description: 'Door for one task: `fgos run "<prompt>"` builds one Unit from the prompt (read-only unless --writes) and runs it headless through a collaboration pattern (solo, reviewed, panel, debate); `--unit <file>` runs one Unit you wrote, `--resume` continues a unit run. Planned work -- several Units with an order, or a registered preset such as a panel discussion -- takes the other door, `fgos workflow start <preset>|--units <file>`. Also "record" for inline producer turns.',
    parameters: {
      type: 'object',
      positional: ['prompt'],
      properties: {
        'stance-options': { type: 'string', description: "Pipe-separated stance options for a council run." },
